about_the_game:
Features

  • Fast-Paced Combat: Take down swarms of aliens with quick reflexes and calculated precision. Chain kills into streaks to earn extra points.

  • Story: Engaging 3D cutscenes and professional voice acting that bring your journey to life.

  • Multiple endings: Are you able to get a great score? You'll be rewarded with an alternative ending to the story and cinematic!

  • Diverse Enemies: Face a variety of alien species, each with unique movement patterns, projectile attacks, and behaviors to keep every encounter fresh.

  • Boss Battles: Test your mettle against powerful alien bosses that demand every ounce of strategy and dodging ability.

  • Difficulty adjustments: Three difficulty modes that adapt to each player.

  • Fun achievements: Unlock them by exploiting enemy mechanics.

short_description: Blood Aliens 3 is a story-driven vertical scrolling space shooter where you blast through alien waves to save planet Earth from alien annihilation.
